'''2011 Bespin Regionals Mark Peterson DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' OMGWTFBBQTTO
* '''Username:''' Lukes Bionic Hand
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
